_comment: Per-metric floors, not one global 0.8. With 9 classification cases a single
silently broken case scores 0.889 and would clear a shared floor — while an
integrity suite that lets ONE fabricated citation through is a correctness
failure, not a quality dip. So the suites whose job is 'never fabricate' are
pinned at 1.00 and the accuracy-style suites carry a realistic bar.
max_regression is the drop from evals/baseline.json that fails the run, so a
slide from 1.00 to 0.89 is caught even while still above the floor.
